factSources.text: With Saturn in Aries, Saturn is in fall, so discipline and initiative start out at odds; the work is developing initiative without recklessness and authority without constant combat. Patience becomes the tool that makes courage sustainable.

factSources.text: Saturn describes time, structure, boundaries, maturity, responsibility, limits, discipline, and the lessons that ask someone to become more capable and realistic. It shows where life may move slowly, but also where lasting strength can be built. Saturn takes about twenty-nine years to move through all twelve signs and spends roughly two and a half years in each sign. Its sign describes the style of the lesson; its house shows where commitment, pressure, and mastery develop over time. When Saturn resides in Aries, your life lessons center around self-assertion and individuality. Discipline and patience become tools you need to master to overcome impulsive actions. You learn to cultivate the courage to take the lead and stand up for yourself without being overly confrontational.
